_comment: Fixture answers for --dry-run. Hand-written, NOT real API output -- realistic enough to exercise mention_detection.py and the SQLite writer end to end with zero API spend. Same texts as the demo answers in data/demo_monitoring.json. Keyed by question_id, then engine. Questions without their own entry use "_default" (neutral answers naming only fictional competitors), so --dry-run covers every question set. Some entries carry invented search_queries (the engine's own web searches) for the Question Radar dry run.
